title: Loop L2 SapI Type IIS Cloning into pCs Vectors
author: Eftychis Frangedakis
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.92fh8bn

steps.title: Determine DNA concentrations
steps.instruction: Determine the concentration of each required DNA plasmid (L1 plasmids and pCs acceptor plasmid) using spectrophotometry (Nanodrop).

steps.title: Prepare plasmid aliquots
steps.instruction: Prepare aliquots of each plasmid at the specified concentrations: 15 nM for L1 plasmids and 7.5 nM for the acceptor pCs vector.

substeps.instruction: To calculate 15 nM concentration in ng/μL: Divide the plasmid length in bp (N) by 110 (approximation of 15∙10^(-9)mol/L x ((607.4 x N ) + 157.9)g/mol x 10^(-6)L/μL x 10^9ng/g).
To calculate 7.5 nM concentration in ng/μL: Divide the plasmid length in bp (N) by 220.

steps.title: Prepare Loop assembly master mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the Loop assembly Even Level reaction master mix (MM) according to the provided table.

steps.title: Prepare plasmid mix
steps.instruction: In a 0.2 mL tube, combine 1 μL of each of the 4 L1 plasmids and 1 μL of the pCs vector. Mix well.

steps.title: Combine master mix and plasmids
steps.instruction: Add 5 μL of the master mix to the 5 μL of plasmid mix to reach a final volume of 10 μL. Mix well.

steps.title: Perform thermocycler program
steps.instruction: Place samples in a thermocycler and run the following program:

substeps.instruction: Assembly: 26 cycles of 37 °C for 3 min and 16 °C for 4 min.
Termination and enzyme denaturation: 50 °C for 5 min and 80 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Transform E. coli cells
steps.instruction: Transform 20 μL of chemically competent E. coli cells (transformation efficiency of 1 × 10^7 transformants/µg plasmid DNA) using 2 μL of the Loop assembly reaction.

substeps.instruction: Plate the transformation on LB agar plates containing 100 μg/mL spectinomycin and 40 μg/mL of X-gal for blue-white screening.

steps.title: Screen and confirm colonies
steps.instruction: Identify white colonies, which likely contain the L2 insert cloned into the pCs vector (blue colonies contain undigested pCs vector with LacZ), and confirm the insert via Sanger sequencing.

substeps.instruction: For pCs vectors, use primers pC_F (GCAACGCTCTGTCATCGTTAC) and pC_R (GTAACTTAGGACTTGTGCGACATGTC).
For pCschlo vectors, use primers pC_F and pC_R2 (CAATCTGCTCTGATGCCGCATAGTTAAG).
